traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: As a bonus action, the cranium rat can shed dim light from its brain in a 5-foot radius or extinguish the light.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.text: The cranium rat is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
